findings.obligation: P4 and Y2: an existing Portfolio keeps its stored value after upgrade; a row written before the change reads on.
findings.observation: Line 72 reads 'var existing = await library.ACreateIsSaved(WhatTheCreateSays.SwitchOn);', so the row is written by the new code. The older-client save then reads it back. No row written with the pre-change schema is read, so the historical default path that HistoricalSchemaPatch mirrors is not observed.
findings.remediation: Seed a row through the pre-change schema (the HistoricalSchemaPatch helper), then read it after the change and assert on. Owner: oracle. Non-blocking for craft; completion obligation.
